en.ammaar-muslim: [3/-] Tafsir al-Qummi: My father from Hammad from Hariz from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام that he (i.e.

the Imam) recited: “Ihdina l-Sirata l-Mustaqim Sirata Man An’amta Alayhim Ghayri l-Maghdhub Alayhim wa Ghayr al-Dhalin”. He (the Imam) said: The Maghdhub Alayhim (those angered upon) are the Nussab (i.e. haters of the Ahl al-Bayt) while the Dhalin (those astray) are the Jews and Christians
